note: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands are a British overseas territory under the British Nationality Act 1981, and a British overseas territories citizen can hold a British passport, as GOV.UK says; from the islands that's the United Kingdom's application from outside the country, at its fee abroad. A child born there to a parent who is a British citizen in their own right is a British citizen too, as the same page says, and holds the same passport.
